json.title: Endless Coastal Summer
json.logline: A dreamy gouache memory of driving to the coast where time stands still in golden light.

palette: soft sage green in distant foliage
character_rules: one protagonist appears in every scene with the same face, hair length and build
wardrobe is identical from the first scene to the last
the face stays readable in at least three-quarter profile
style_bible.lighting: cinematic low-angle golden-hour light with gentle halation and soft falloff
style_bible.medium: loose gouache painting with visible brush strokes and softly blended colour

events.visual: Intimate opening on a young person bathed in golden light
Gouache paint textures bloom outward into a winding road
Sunlight intensifies across the frame as momentum builds
Vast golden vista opens wide over an endless ocean highway
Multi-layered collage of glowing summer memories
A single warm piano chord resonates over the ocean horizon

scenes.camera_note: Slow steady push into a three-quarter portrait.
scenes.action: A young person with shoulder-length brown hair in an olive green jacket gazes forward against a warm sunset.
scenes.setting: A high coastal lookout overlooking a quiet road at dusk.

scenes.camera_note: Gentle lateral drift creating depth between subject and distant foliage.
scenes.action: Gouache paint textures bloom around the young person near a vintage convertible on the coastal road.
scenes.setting: A sunlit coastal highway winding alongside deep blue-violet ocean cliffs.

scenes.camera_note: Tilt up from the jacket lapel to hair blowing in the sea wind.
scenes.action: Coastal wind rustles the young person's shoulder-length brown hair.
scenes.setting: An open-top car interior facing the glowing sunset horizon.

scenes.camera_note: Rapid push in focusing on the warm light across the face.
scenes.action: Golden sunlight floods across the young person's face in three-quarter profile.
scenes.setting: The front seat of a car driving along an elevated ocean bluff.

scenes.camera_note: Wide cinematic pull out revealing the endless ocean road.
scenes.action: The young person extends an arm into the warm ocean breeze above an endless sea horizon.
scenes.setting: A panoramic coastal highway glowing under an endless golden-hour sky.

scenes.camera_note: Multi-plane parallax movement drifting across painted memory fragments.
scenes.action: Layered gouache paint strokes frame the young person smiling against sun-bleached terracotta cliffs.
scenes.setting: A scenic beach pull-off surrounded by soft sage foliage and rose sunset clouds.

scenes.camera_note: Smooth dolly backward into quiet twilight expanse.
scenes.action: The young person sits quietly on the car hood during evening twilight over the ocean.
scenes.setting: A quiet coastal overlook lingering in deep blue-violet shadows and soft twilight glow.
